{{Quote|Ah, the 'Detritus Satellites'. A peculiar "collection" of droids, if you will. The rumors have been proven true. We, the Black Sun, have formed an alliance with these little maggots.|[[A'kiian "Maleficus" Bloodlight]]|<ref name="SWG:AL">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|A Log}}</ref>}}
The '''Detritus Satellites''' were one of several groups of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture]] droid scavengers active at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|Amusing, if you ask me. What could we, the mighty Black Sun, possibly want from them? It must have something to do with their little mockup of an "outpost".|A'kiian "Maleficus" Bloodlight|<ref name="SWG:AL" />}}
The Detritus Satellites were a group of independent<ref name="SWG:AAA" /> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="SWG:AL" /> [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid]]<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> scavengers.<ref name="SCDS" /> The Detritus Satellites had built a makeshift outpost in [[Area D-7s1]] of the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]], using old scraps collected from a nearby junk field. The outpost was powered by electrical currents and provided fellow droids with shelter and repair.<ref name="SCDS" /> They were also active in [[Area D-513]].<ref name="SWG:AAA" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they formed an alliance with the powerful [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime cartel and with [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]'s [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]]. This alliances included a non-aggression pact, the rights to trade with each other and the right to render the alliance null and void at any time. It did not entitle the groups to demand support in battle against enemies. The agreements were signed by [[X10-700 "Destroyer"]] for the Detritus Satellites, [[Tvinnii Blackrunn]] for the Black Sun, and [[Vors d'Oesti]] for the Lok Revenants.<ref name="SWG:AAA" /> Not all pilots of the Black Sun were happy with this agreement and voiced this opinion in private messages, among them [[A'kiian "Maleficus" Bloodlight]].<ref name="SWG:AL" />
